b:
"Why are you doing this?"
that voice
scolds me

He orders me:
do not write

Defying him
I write

At least today
let
his true face
be revealed

He is
the companion
of my
loneliness

He is also
the one
who ruins
my sleep

Politely
he slips
indecent thoughts
into me

He is
a liberal,
a conservative,
an enemy of the masses

Switching parties
he leaves me
shaken

When I forget myself
he blurts out
something

So many embarrassments

Even now
he is holding
talks
with me

We are
talking to each other

in a single voice

Can't you hear
our
chatter…?
note: The title echoes a famous line from Andal's Thiruppavai, "pēccaravam kēṭṭilaiyō" ("can't you hear the chatter?"), sung to wake a sleeping friend.
